items.text: Giants expected to change RB rotation: Najee Harris larger role, Cam Skattebo downgraded after fumbles but still involved. All 4 RBs active. Levitan notes Skattebo poor Yards Over Expected and 4 fumbles.
items.why: Fumbles; sources via Raanan/Schefter; poor efficiency data.
items.implication: Skattebo flex riskier; Berry still prefers his explosiveness vs NO but notes risk. Harris upside spike.
items.opportunity: Harris carries increase; committee dilutes both.
items.conflict: Berry still starts Cam over Harris if forced choice for explosiveness/TD chance.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins listed as GAME-TIME DECISION in ETR Sunday AM injury summary; will workout pregame to determine status after limited practice.
items.why: Ankle; practiced once this week; pregame workout planned per Rapoport.
items.implication: High risk sit if no clear active confirmation; monitor inactive window.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Browns RB committee opens for backups.

items.text: Tyler Warren GAME-TIME DECISION per ETR weekend injury summary.
items.implication: Monitor for Colts TE usage; sit if uncertain in early games.
items.opportunity: If OUT, other Colts pass catchers gain targets.

items.text: Mike Evans GAME-TIME DECISION alongside Christian Kirk in ETR summary.
items.implication: Berry loves him vs WSH if active; high upside but risk.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Bucs WR targets redistribute (Egbuka etc).

items.text: David Montgomery inactive for Texans (groin); London game.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for remaining HOU RBs.

items.text: Eagles officially placed Jalen Hurts on IR; out indefinitely with superficial blood clot. Tanner McKee starts; Berry pushes McKee pickup.
items.implication: McKee QB streamer; Eagles skill (Smith, Goedert) still viable but lower floor; Saquon already out.
items.opportunity: No Hurts rushing TDs; pass game volume to WRs/TE.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr officially active for Texans debut in London.
items.implication: Start/flex MHJ; targets available with Dell out.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets in HOU offense vs JAX.

items.text: Caleb Williams EXPECTED TO PLAY; Rapoport/Schefter confirm Bears plan to start him after full practice week.
items.implication: Upgrade Bears skill players; solid QB streamer vs ATL.
items.opportunity: Full snaps expected; boosts Olave? Wait no, Bears WRs/TEs.

items.text: Chris Olave and Alvin Kamara both EXPECTED TO PLAY despite Q tags (illness/back).
items.why: Sources confirm both will go vs Giants.
items.implication: Start both confidently; Kamara volume intact.
items.opportunity: Full roles; Shough playing through broken hand bones may limit efficiency.

items.text: AJ Brown and TreVeyon Henderson EXPECTED/LIKELY TO PLAY; Brown officially activated.
items.why: Brown activated to 53; Henderson ankle likely; Pats near full health.
items.implication: Start AJB if rostered; Henderson RB upgrade.

items.text: Deebo Samuel NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY.
items.why: Injury designation leads to sit expectation.
items.implication: Sit Deebo; Washington WRs/TEs or other options rise.
items.opportunity: Commanders pass catchers (McLaurin if active, etc) gain.

items.text: Sean Tucker NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY (quad); Rapoport confirms Q and not expected.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup snaps increase for remaining RBs.

items.text: Jaydon Blue ACTIVATED; Eagles signed him after placing Hurts on IR.
items.why: Hurts IR opens roster spot; Blue signed.
items.implication: Eagles RB depth with Barkley also out; Pierce/Blue committee.
items.opportunity: Potential carries for Blue/Pierce behind compromised line.

items.text: Berry strongly recommends picking up Tanner McKee in any league needing QB; not worried about Eagles skill with him starting for Hurts.
items.why: Hurts IR; McKee can play, volume for skill players.
items.opportunity: Pass volume remains for Smith/Goedert etc.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES Mike Evans vs WSH (WR4) due to Commanders defense being a buffet for pass catchers.
items.why: Soft matchup vs WSH pass defense.
items.opportunity: High target/TD upside in favorable spot.

items.text: Berry LOVES Drake London vs CHI (WR6) for bankable usage.
Berry LOVES Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) for elite recent usage and soft run defense.
Berry HATES Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28) due to tough matchup and QB issues.
items.why: Seattle tough on WRs; shaky QB situation.
